transcript: Speaker A: PW Talk app aapko sirf 7 din mein fluently English bolna sikhata hai. Agar bade-bade cricketers English bolna improve kar sakte hain, toh aap bhi kar sakte ho. Bas, consistency zaroori hai. Roz thoda time nikaal ke practice karna hi difference create karta hai. Is bhram mein mat raho ki Instagram aur YouTube se aap sab kuch seekh jaoge. Sirf videos dekhne se zyada bolne ki practice karna zaroori hota hai, aur wahi ye app karne mein help karta hai. PW Talk ke saath aap real life situations mein English bolna try kar sakte ho, aur dheere-dheere hesitation kam hota hai. Toh rukna mat, roz practice karo aur apni progress khud notice karo. Install Now par click karo aur PW Talk app try karo. [The PW Talk app teaches you to speak English fluently in just 7 days. If famous cricketers can improve their English, so can you. Consistency is key. Practicing daily makes the difference. Don't assume you can learn everything from Instagram or YouTube; active speaking practice is essential, which is what this app facilitates. PW Talk lets you practice in real-life scenarios to reduce hesitation. Keep practicing daily and track your progress. Click 'Install Now' to try PW Talk.]
on_screen_text:
बस 7 दिन और English में बनो Confident Speaker [Just 7 days and become a Confident Speaker in English]
PWTalk app आपको [PWTalk app teaches you]
fluently English बोलना सिखाता है. [to speak English fluently.]

तो आप भी कर सकते हो. [then you can too.]

रोज़ थोड़ा टाइम निकाल के practice करना ही difference create करता है. [Taking out a little time daily to practice is what makes a difference.]
इस भ्रम में मत रहो कि Instagram और YouTube से आप सब कुछ सीख जाओगे. [Don't be under the illusion that you will learn everything from Instagram and YouTube.]
सिर्फ वीडियोस देखने से ज़्यादा बोलने की practice ज़रूरी होता है. [More than just watching videos, speaking practice is necessary.]
और वही ये app करता है. [And that is what this app does.]

Install Now पर click करो और PWTalk app try करो. [Click on Install Now and try the PWTalk app.]

summary: A presenter explains that the PW Talk app helps users speak English fluently in 7 days through consistent daily practice. He emphasizes that active speaking practice is more effective than passively watching videos on social media. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app.
